description: This file contains utility functions, type traits, and mathematical operations for Metal GPU programming within the c10 namespace, including vector type definitions, type promotion, math functions, and complex number operations.

classes.name: pair
classes.description: Template struct representing a pair of values, with default second type same as first.

classes.name: vectypes
classes.description: Template specializations defining vector types for various scalar types.

classes.name: OpMathType
classes.description: Template struct for defining operation math types, with specializations for certain types.

classes.name: AccumulationType
classes.description: Template struct for defining accumulation types for higher precision, with specializations.

methods.name: max
methods.description: Returns the maximum of two floating point or integral values, handling unordered cases for floating point.

methods.name: min
methods.description: Returns the minimum of two floating point or integral values, handling unordered cases for floating point.

methods.name: floor_divide
methods.description: Performs floor division for integral and floating point scalar types.

methods.name: fmod
methods.description: Computes the floating point modulus for floating types or the remainder for integral types.

methods.name: cast_to
methods.description: Casts between scalar, complex, and vector types, with special handling for complex types.

methods.name: mul
methods.description: Performs multiplication, with special handling for complex types.

methods.name: div
methods.description: Performs division, with special handling for complex types.

methods.name: remainder
methods.description: Calculates the remainder or floating point remainder for scalar types.

methods.name: pow
methods.description: Calculates power for scalar and complex types, including integer and floating point exponentiation.

methods.name: log1p
methods.description: Computes log(1 + x) with higher precision, including overload for float2.

methods.name: conj
methods.description: Returns the conjugate of a complex number, specialized for float2 and half2.
